description: Defines a wave's win condition/order type, its display text, numeric thresholds and binding-vow exclusions.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_MissionOrder. The active MissionWave->Id_MissionOrder is resolved through MissionOrderDataTables (DTM+0x9D0) in gameplay, UI and pre-battle filtering; the finder supports skipping None ids. No observed consumer reads the member as a value.

OrderType.simple: Kind of objective or wave special rule.
OrderType.technical: EGameMissionOrderType, default None. BattleStory_IsMissionOrderAchieved switches on it: Protracted compares elapsed TimeLimit to Value[0]; Event compares enemy HitPointRate to Value[0]; SuperCursedEnergyAttack, SuperCursedEnergyAttackFinish and SpecialTagCombo require a matching log hit >= 1. Boss changes wave-transition UI and radar cost display. Raw value 3 makes an Arcade result treat remaining time as exhausted for the winning player; raw value 4 with Value[1] > 0 sets enemy HitPointMin to Value[0] times base HitPoint. GetMissionOrderType returns Invalid when no order is active.

Value.simple: Numeric parameters for the order condition and display.
Value.technical: TArray<float>, default empty. Value[0] is the comparison threshold in Protracted and Event conditions, the VALUE text parameter in the in-battle order widget, and the HitPointMin rate for OrderType 4. Value[1] gates that OrderType-4 HitPointMin behaviour (> 0). Consumers index by position without a general length check, so rows must supply enough entries for their OrderType.

Id_BattleText_OrderName.simple: Localized text id for the order name.
Id_BattleText_OrderName.technical: FName, default None. Displayed by the in-battle mission-order widget, the wave overlay's subtext, the situation overview win-condition title and the versus-enemy interval wave-info widget. The table supplies a text id; localization strings are not stored here.

Id_BattleText_OrderDetail.simple: Localized text id for the order description.
Id_BattleText_OrderDetail.technical: FName, default None. Shown in the in-battle mission-order detail widget with a VALUE float parameter taken from Value[0], and as plain text in the situation overview and story character-select mission info widgets.

ExcludeBindingVowsEffectType.simple: Binding-vow effect types disallowed for waves using this order.
ExcludeBindingVowsEffectType.technical: TArray<EGameBindingVowsEffectType>, default empty. During PvE interval setup, each candidate binding vow's effect rows are expanded and if any EffectType is contained in this array the candidate vow is removed before weighted picking. The same filter is applied separately for MissionTask.ExcludeBindingVowsEffectType; both filters operate on the same candidate list.

notes: The exported asset contains 18 rows with FGameDataTableRow_MissionOrder; the manager loads MissionOrderDataTable into MissionOrderDataTables (DTM+0x9D0).

The active order pointer is cached on FStudioBattleMissionTaskSystem (System360) by SetupArcade/SetupPvE/SetupStory, so aliases such as AGameBattleManager::GetMissionOrder and local Order variables all lead back to this table's row.
OrderType numeric cases in reconstructed code (for example raw 3 and 4) are recorded from consumer branches; the enum headers provide the named cases where the source names them.

Order finder 0x1048c30 is labelled behavioural in status/functions.json; this documents reconstructed behaviour, not byte parity. Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspectable.

usages.detail: Evaluates task/order success and failure conditions from OrderType and Value.
SetupArcade/SetupPvE/SetupStory resolve and cache the order for the active wave.
Displays order name/detail and inserts the numeric VALUE text parameter.
Chooses boss versus normal wave transition and overlay subtext from OrderType.
